title: New meaning changes a promise’s feel

captions.physics: Returning to a reminder understood differently
captions.energy: Matching expectations to an accepted arrangement
captions.emotions: Feeling impressions of an answer shift

meaning: You can return to a reminder understood differently and match expectations to an accepted arrangement, noticing impressions change without automatically changing the promise itself.
text: Judgement in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in returning to a reminder whose meaning is now understood differently. Justice in energy supports readiness to match expectations to an accepted arrangement. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions brings shifting impressions of an answer. You can hear words differently when they previously seemed a demand. A new response does not redefine all agreement’s substance without actual confirmation.

For example, you return to “You wanted to ask about that today”. Previously heard as insistence on an answer, the reminder now clearly follows your own request not to lose the question. **An accepted arrangement helps a reminder sound different**. Frustration may turn to relief or surprise. Yet promising to remind contains no duty to insist on conversation. Present readiness can be named separately; a changed impression requires neither immediate continuation nor treating earlier discomfort as proof of somebody being wrong.

Difficulty arises if this pleasant turn permits reminding each other about any subject without fresh agreement. Emotional change enlarges the original commitment. Constructive Justice helps preserve acceptance’s scope and separately hear another request. You can enjoy accuracy and limit today’s answer; changed experience does not replace agreement, while new understanding of one occasion makes no future insistence automatically appropriate or compulsory participation.
